_readme: The photos the launch cutscene (launch.html) shows, by role, written in by build.py. file is under web/cassini-os/media/launch (resized to 1600 px from the originals at url); credit is the line shown under the photo; from/to are [scale, x %, y %] for the slow drift across it; focus is the CSS object-position of the photo when it fills a screen of another shape. Every photo here needs its own line in credits.json (the launch-photos entry).

prep.alt: Cassini, wrapped in gold foil with the Huygens probe on its side, in a clean room at Kennedy Space Center

pad.alt: The Titan IVB/Centaur lit up on Launch Complex 40 at night, its service tower pulled back

liftoff.alt: Liftoff: the Titan IVB clears the tower on a column of flame

climb.credit: U.S. Department of Defense, Defense Visual Information Center · National Archives 6504408
climb.alt: The Titan IVB climbing away from the pad on its flame

trail.alt: A long exposure of the rocket's arc into the night sky over the booster recovery ship Liberty Star
